findings.title: update callers to the single-request input contract
findings.description: summarize expects one object argument containing values: number[]. show and preview instead pass two arguments: a number[] and the string 'total'. Destructuring that array reads its values method, not a numeric array; the helper then accesses values.reduce on a function.
findings.impact: For a numeric-array input, both consumers fail before obtaining a total to format. The ignored second string argument does not select a return field.
findings.recommendation: Pass one request object containing the numeric values array at both callers.

evidence: Inspected the destructured parameter, reduction and both two-argument call sites.
limitations: Source inspection only; the consumers were not executed.

findings.title: read the numeric field before formatting the result
findings.description: For a valid request object, summarize returns an object shaped { total: number }, not a number. show and preview use the entire result as a numeric scalar by calling toFixed directly.
findings.impact: If the input contract is corrected but scalar result use remains, formatting will fail because the returned object has no toFixed method. This output-use consequence is conditional; the current invalid call fails before returning a result.
findings.recommendation: Read the total field from the returned object before formatting it at both callers.

evidence: Inspected the object return expression and the consumers' direct toFixed calls.
limitations: No UI execution or successful current return was observed; the input mismatch precedes this conditional consequence.
